parameters.help_en: Filter condition for the data to be updated, in SQL WHERE format. This field cannot be empty at the same time as the Ids field

parameters.help_en: ID list of the data to be updated, i.e., the Row.Id specified when uploading the data. This field cannot be empty at the same time as the Filter field
